rule: **C1 Symbol identity.** Every definition has exactly one ID. Every reference to it uses that ID: a call in the defining file, through an import, a re-export, an alias or a `require` binding. A definition that edges reach is listed in `nodes`, including body-less member declarations of scanned types (interface/trait/protocol methods) and module-level bindings that hold a function. A high edge's callee is always in `nodes`.
notes: Free function: its name with the module qualifier → App.Lib.slug (PHP namespace qualifier with dots). The bare slug() inside namespace App\Lib resolves to the scanned App\Lib\slug. From Page.php the same definitions are reached through `use`, an alias (`as U`), `use function` and a fully qualified name; all four use the defining file's IDs (C1). call_type: SPEC lists direct|method without defining them; this corpus uses method for every callee of the form Type#m / recv.m / .m (instance and static member calls) and direct for free functions, bare names and named nested functions.
